title: Answer: intelligence needs a controlled focus of attention

statements.text: AST gives no full account of intelligence, and it does not explain decisions or creativity. It holds that the human ability to focus limited resources and control that focus depends on the attention schema, so intelligent artificial systems may need one.

sources.quote: Without understanding the subjective awareness piece, it may be impossible to build artificial intelligence that has a human-like ability to focus its computational resources and intelligently control that focus.
